comment: Data-quality scorecard: monthly DQ score (Apr-2023 .. Sep-2026) per table of the bronze, shared and silver layers and per DQ dimension (completeness, validity, uniqueness, timeliness, consistency) - score 0-1 = share of evaluated rows passing, rules evaluated / failed, rows evaluated / failed - with the previous month's score, the incident behind each explainable dip (Jun-2026 payments replay: uniqueness; Feb-May 2026 KYC workflow migration: timeliness; 11-15 Aug 2026 Japan share outage: timeliness / freshness) and a below-95% flag. History is simulated and deterministic; the latest month (Sep-2026) equals the current DQ run (fact_dq_rule_result). Scores are point-in-time per month: average them, never sum. Grain: one row per month per layer-qualified table per DQ dimension.
